snippet.title: Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling: The Recall DLC - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
ANOTHER BIG NEWS! 📣
Excited to present "Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling: The Recall"! 🗓️ 📼

A new DLC featuring a short spin-off story in the world of "7 Days To Think About It".
A new place to explore, new characters and a question to answer.

Coming June 30th, 2026! 🥳

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4174510/Looking_Up_I_See_Only_A_Ceiling_The_Recall/
